quote: Papachristou’s petition for rehearing with suggestion for rehearing en banc was granted, and as a result the panel opinion was vacated.
note: 8th Cir. en banc (same docket 88-2694) reverses district court; preceding sentence cites P 884 F.2d 1116 as the panel affirmance.

quote: By an order issued February 10, 1976, this court, en banc, granted appellees’ suggestion for rehearing en banc and vacated the decision of the panel.
note: D.C. Cir. en banc (same docket 73-1991); E reports the en banc order's vacatur of P (521 F.2d 1024); the order itself is not in the item.

quote: For the reasons stated, the panel decision is Vacated and the judgment of the district court is Affirmed.
note: 7th Cir. en banc (same docket 80-1940) vacates P 671 F.2d 1011 and affirms denial of habeas; fragmented opinions; E also includes later denial of reconsideration.

quote: United States v. $1,106,775.00 in U.S. Currency, 131 F.4th 710, 715 (9th Cir. 2025), reh’g en banc granted, opinion vacated, 157 F.4th 1102 (9th Cir. 2025).
note: 9th Cir. en banc (same docket 22-16499); vacatur stated only in E's subsequent-history citation of P, attributing it to the grant order 157 F.4th 1102 (order not in item); E reverses and remands.

Different cases and courts: P is St. Jean v. State (Fla. 3d DCA, per curiam affirmance); E is Fravel v. Haughey (Fla. 5th DCA) considered en banc sua sponte in first instance; only the docket number 97-2718 coincides.

quote: IT IS ORDERED that this cause shall be reheard by the court en bane with oral argument on a date hereafter to be fixed.
note: E is itself only the 5th Cir. order granting rehearing en banc of P's appeal (same docket 97-10685), not an en banc merits decision; it does not say P is vacated (vacatur would follow only from circuit rule, not stated).

Different cases: P is DaimlerChrysler v. Del. Dep't of Ins. (No. 105, 2007); E is Ingres Corp. v. CA, Inc. (No. 105, 2010); Delaware Supreme Court sitting as its ordinary full bench (en Banc), not a rehearing.

quote: Ordered that the said judgments of the District Court for the Northern District of New York be and they hereby are affirmed upon consideration of the merits
note: 2d Cir. in banc order (consolidated Rodriguez/Katzoff/Kritsky, Katzoff docket 35300) reheard P (441 F.2d 558, which reversed) and affirmed the district court; no words vacating P, so P is displaced only implicitly.

quote: Upon the vote of a majority of nonrecused active judges, it is ordered that this case be reheard en banc pursuant to Federal Rule of Appellate Procedure 35(a) and Circuit Rule 35-3. The three-judge panel opinion is vacated.
note: 9th Cir. Begay (14-10080); order 15 F.4th 1254 vacates panel opinion; in E (33 F.4th 1081) the only vacatur words are Ikuta's partial dissent citing P 934 F.3d 1033 'reh’g en banc granted, opinion vacated, 15 F.4th 1254' (cite names P with order as subsequent history); E majority affirms convictions, vacates restitution.

quote: Accordingly, it is ORDERED that the previous decision of this court is vacated, the mandate is stayed, and this case is restored to the docket as a pending appeal.
note: E (854 F.3d 367) is itself the 6th Cir. order granting rehearing en banc of P (unpublished panel affirmance, 15-6122), quoting 6th Cir. R. 35(b); not an en banc merits decision.
